author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,

I am pleading for one last chance to prove myself.  If you provide this, this will be my very last chance: if I do fail it ban me and I won't be able to appeal but I'll make sure that this won't happen.  I now can really make sure I won't break any rules in any way. I really want this last chance and I will be hugely grateful if you grant me this.

Please take this into account,

From DaCrowMan
